tasks.title: Create CommentController.php
tasks.description: Create lib/Controller/CommentController.php with @NoAdminRequired on all methods; inject ICommentsManager, IUserSession, IRequest; implement listComments returning id/message/actorId/actorDisplayName/creationDateTime
acceptance_criteria: Returns comments array with id, message, actorId, actorDisplayName, creationDateTime

tasks.title: Implement createComment
tasks.description: Validate message 1–5000 chars (return 422 on violation), call ICommentsManager::create() with actorType COMMENT_ACTOR_TYPE_USERS, return 201 with comment object
acceptance_criteria: Return 422 on empty or too-long message
Return 201 with comment object on success

tasks.title: Implement deleteComment
tasks.description: Fetch comment, check actorId === $userId OR user is NC admin, call ICommentsManager::delete($commentId), return 204; return 403 if not authorized, 404 if not found

tasks.title: Implement getCommentCounts batch endpoint
tasks.description: Accept ?ids[]=... query param, call ICommentsManager::getNumberOfCommentsForObject per task ID, return map {taskId: count}
acceptance_criteria: Accepts array of task IDs via query param

tasks.title: Register routes in appinfo/routes.php
tasks.description: Register GET /api/tasks/{id}/comments, POST /api/tasks/{id}/comments, DELETE /api/tasks/{id}/comments/{commentId}, GET /api/tasks/comment-counts pointing to CommentController

tasks.title: Create TaskComments.vue component
tasks.description: Create src/components/TaskComments.vue with props: { taskId: String }, fetch comments on mount, store in local ref([]) array
acceptance_criteria: Renders actorDisplayName, relative timestamp, message for each comment
Compose area with textarea, Post button, char-count warning
Post action: optimistic prepend, 201 success, error toast on failure
Delete action: own comments only (or admin), confirmation dialog

tasks.title: Wire TaskComments.vue tab into TaskDetail sidebar
tasks.description: Import TaskComments.vue and add as tab alongside Details, Files, and Audit Trail; pass taskId as prop; label: Comments
acceptance_criteria: Comments tab visible in task detail sidebar

tasks.title: Add fetchCommentCounts to tasks store
tasks.description: Add fetchCommentCounts(taskIds) action to src/store/tasks.js — calls batch endpoint, stores result in commentCounts map keyed by task ID
acceptance_criteria: Single batch call with all visible task IDs

tasks.title: Add comment count badge to TaskCard.vue
tasks.description: Conditionally render NcCounterBubble showing commentCounts[task.id] only when count > 0
acceptance_criteria: Single batch call dispatched after tasks load

tasks.title: PHPUnit: listComments
tasks.description: Unit test for CommentController::listComments — mock ICommentsManager, assert response structure and HTTP 200

tasks.title: PHPUnit: createComment
tasks.description: Unit test asserting 201 on valid input, 422 on empty message, 422 on message > 5000 chars

tasks.title: PHPUnit: deleteComment
tasks.description: Unit test asserting 204 for own comment, 204 for admin, 403 for non-owner non-admin, 404 for missing comment
